title: Pong
description: Pong against a computer opponent, with knob and touch controls, difficulty settings, and saved matches

screens.name: HELP
screens.title: Pong controls
items: Your paddle is on the left. Turn the knob clockwise to move down and counterclockwise to move up. Hold the controller tilted up or down for continuous movement.
Tap the court at the height where you want your paddle. The arrow buttons also move it. Paddle movement is limited to the court.
Press the controller or tap Serve to start a rally. Every point waits for another serve, including points scored by the computer.
Send the ball past the computer's paddle to score. The first side to the selected score wins. Hitting near a paddle's edge creates a steeper return; rallies get faster after each hit.
Difficulty changes the computer's speed, reaction and accuracy, plus ball speed. Difficulty and match length apply to new matches; knob sensitivity changes immediately.
BACK or Pause returns to the menu and saves. Calls, popups, leaving the app and vehicle movement pause play. Resume explicitly when ready; a saved rally has a short ready pause.

screens.name: NEW_GAME
screens.title: Start a new match?
items: Your current saved match will be replaced. Your best rally is kept.
